item.title: Cleanup efforts underway for oil spill near Port Fourchon
item.description: Gov. Jeff Landry provided more information regarding the Feb. 26 oil spill that occurred near Port Fourchon.

item.title: Housing Authority of New Orleans advocates to help Guste High Rise residents avoid displacement
item.description: The Housing Authority of New Orleans (HANO) advocated on behalf of residents of Guste Homes High Rise to preserve the development of public housing for elderly and disabled individuals.

item.title: Two-story Lakeview home destroyed in early morning fire
item.description: An overnight fire in the Lakeview neighborhood claimed a two-story home on Friday morning, March 6.

item.title: NOPD searches for suspects connected to alleged gold chain snatching in French Quarter
item.description: The New Orleans Police Department is asking for the public's help in finding two suspects who are accused of a property snatching incident in the French Quarter.

item.title: Louisiana group back home after being trapped in Israel bomb shelter
item.description: Louisiana State Chaplain Michael Sprague and 43 others spent six days visiting biblical sites, as part of a 13-day pilgrimage through the Holy Land. But upon arriving in Jerusalem, he said the peace immediately disappeared.

item.title: Gretna Italian-Irish parade to change time due to inclement weather
item.description: Due to the threat of inclement weather, the time of the Gretna Italian-Irish parade has been changed.

item.title: Family remembers man fatally struck by truck, calls for improved safety measures
item.description: On the night of Sunday, March 1, Chad Williams was hit by a car on Jean Lafitte Boulevard in Jefferson Parish. He died two days later in the hospital, leaving behind a wife, a teenage son, and many loved ones.
